The Nasdaq 100 Index plunged on Tuesday, led by another steep decline in chipmakers as a relief rally in technology stocks gave way to renewed worries about the durability of the AI trade. Plans for new US tariffs also weighed on stocks. Also, our CFO briefing on how banks are financing the next waves of data centers. Plus, Huang’s return to Nivida signals the start of the too-big-to-fail CEO. All on the latest episode of “Bloomberg Businessweek Daily.”
